text: Lumbar MRI 2025-04-22 (ordered for low back pain with left-sided sciatica): L5-S1 mild disc desiccation with a left paracentral annular fissure and a small/shallow disc protrusion; no canal or foraminal narrowing; other levels normal; no fracture. Programming: neutral-spine hinging, avoid loaded or fatigued spinal flexion (sit-ups/GHD sit-ups, rounded pulls, sloppy rowing under fatigue); any return of leg symptoms is a red flag (stop, see a doctor).
